records.title: Fictional employee data sharing clarification
records.text: For an unclear employee-data sharing request, identify the data categories, recipient or vendor, purpose, storage locations, safeguards, and relevant review record. A statement that someone approved it does not establish that all required reviews and approvals cover the proposed sharing. Do not share until required approvals are complete. Ask Privacy or Legal to clarify missing approval scope; this assistant cannot verify it.
